grapStages.name: Stage I — Poor Air Quality
grapStages.summary: Strict enforcement of dust control at construction; ban on open municipal solid waste and biomass burning; regular mechanical road sweeping.
grapStages.hint: Check local municipal advisories for dust control compliance.

grapStages.name: Stage II — Very Poor Air Quality
grapStages.summary: Ban on unregulated diesel generator sets (except essential services); enhanced metro and bus frequency; increased parking fees to discourage private vehicle use.
grapStages.hint: Check official notices on DG set restrictions and public transport schedules.

grapStages.name: Stage III — Severe Air Quality
grapStages.summary: Ban on plying BS-III petrol and BS-IV diesel 4-wheelers; complete halt on non-essential construction and demolition; advisories for online primary classes.
grapStages.hint: Check traffic police and transport department circulars for vehicle bans.

grapStages.name: Stage IV — Severe+ Air Quality
grapStages.summary: Prohibition of entry for non-essential diesel trucks; halt on public infrastructure projects; 50% work-from-home advisory for public and private offices.
grapStages.hint: Check state disaster management emergency circulars.

seasons.name: Post-Monsoon & Stubble Burning Smog
seasons.hint: Agricultural residue fires in northwest plains combined with dropping wind speeds trap dense smoke at breathing height.

seasons.name: Peak Winter Inversion & Dense Fog
seasons.hint: Shallow boundary layer height, cold nocturnal radiation inversions, and high humidity trap vehicular and cooking emissions near the surface.

seasons.name: Late Winter Transition
seasons.hint: Gradual daytime solar heating raises boundary layer, though calm night inversions still yield poor morning air.

seasons.name: Summer Dust & Monsoon Cleansing
seasons.hint: Stronger convective winds disperse fine particulates; seasonal monsoon rains provide atmospheric wet scavenging.
